reason: Refuted on value and on feasibility. (1) NOT ONE KNOB ON OUR BASE. lowrefine reads the same env var: _LOWREFINE_MIN_SCORE = BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE (tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.1650-1652). So --set READMIT_MIN_SCORE=0.94 on any K2/exp70g-family BASE also sends every pool row in [0.94,0.965) through the V1284 head refiner: the new readmits AND the existing gapfill rows in that band. Our own builder already warns about this (l.2435-2443 INFO: a value != 0.965 means 'lowrefine's premise shifts: prefer the K1 recipe (LOWREFINE_ENABLE=0)'). The clean form therefore changes two things, or drops lowrefine and becomes a different base. JT's x138 fork has no lowrefine, so his step does not transfer as stated. The proposed dummy gate (nodes +0.1..+1.5%, runtime) does not check the LOWREFINE refined-count shift. (2) WHAT THE KNOB REALLY DOES. In exp70g, DET_THRESHOLD = READMIT_MIN_SCORE = 0.965. The band [0.94,0.965) is sub-threshold peaks that were never ILP candidates, so this is a local detection-threshold drop near open ends. That is the node-addition family, and on the LB it reads 2 of 3 non-positive: readmit 0.947->0.946, det 0.95 0.941->0.940 (plus MIN_TRACK_LEN 4 -0.002, gapfill 0; CONTEXT l.1884). JT gives one +0.001 display on a different base (ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 plus his own PP), and his own local readout was 0 of 2,212 edges changed. So the step is rounding-level on one embryo. (3) 'LAB-BLIND' IS OVERSTATED. The 0-of-6,696 fact is real, but the lab does see readmit's relink knock-on: R12-NF measured that dropping >=0.965 readmits moves 44b6 by -0.0023 and 6bba by +0.0008, with only 0.1-0.7% of them GT-proximal. The quoted -0.0005 is a node-bonus estimate. The exp60 replay at 0.94 was not run. The embryo sign flip is also the private risk: the finding's own P(private<0) is ~0.4-0.5. (4) NO PRIVATE UPSIDE, SOME DOWNSIDE. A public-only slot cannot raise the private score. A lucky 0.957 display would enter V_pub under READ TABLE v2 (9), which excludes only exp77a/tau, and be proposed as a final: winner's curse on a coin-flip lever. (5) RULES. W2 v4 (2)(v) first moves the slot to W3, where knob rungs are banned (v2 (6), W4 AMEND 2 (4)). The trigger case is narrow. The in-sample dummy node gate does not bound node growth on the unseen hidden embryos (old verdict point 4). The GPU quota is already ~20.6-26.5 of 30 h.
